Latest current-base candidate 456ab8feb459e194255ffe193d0f28fe2d6b749e contains main83c5999bb6658c9009c81bc70cb444b8a8e0a9c4 through normal merges. Every scoped feature file is byte-identical to the immediately preceding validated candidate (15 files); no additional implementation changes. Independent parity review is clear. Fresh service RoleOneRolesTest +HandCostTest on latest main passes21 tests /379 assertions; other local gates below remain valid carried evidence for unchanged source. Exact-head full CI is starting; earlier CI statuses/heads below are historical. Draft only; no merge.

Current-base refresh (26 November 2026): normal merge of main3b6ade1fea10bcb73fa367aec6809c70a2862789; new candidate ac98a31a15cd87db04d03d8976d2238c72a1ebcb. All 15 original slice files remain byte-identical. Independent parity review is clear; no new business logic, existing assertion, migration or permission change.

Fresh local checks passed: 30 focused frontend tests, scoped ESLint/Prettier and whitespace checks. Earlier full validation and visual evidence remain carried evidence for the unchanged slice; exact-head full CI is pending. Original stale-base attestation failure is addressed by current-main ancestry. This remains a draft with no merge authorization.

Historical evidence below is superseded only for base/head/CI status by this update.

---

The Stock landing page now has grouped workspace navigation, server-backed summaries and filters, an expandable per-batch/location On-hand list, and helpful-information panels. Existing operations and reference forms stay mounted to preserve drafts. Quantities, units, availability, hold reasons, permissions and report actions retain their existing server bindings.

The owner resumed this existing slice and delegated technical decisions. Six source-pinned assertion groups now follow the extracted renderer while retaining permission, row capability, dates, query, hold, action and focus checks. This was a delegated technical decision, not six new owner tickboxes. The preservation-era proposal/HOLD documents are visibly superseded by `RESUMED-DECISION.md`. Page-local controls measure36px on desktop and44px on mobile.

Validation on the final source:
- Full frontend2208/2208 and focused30/30 pass; five new real Vue runtime cases cover display fidelity, expansion/projection reset, report authority and loading parity.
- Full TypeScript passed; final changes after that were local CSS target classes and tests/docs. Final production build, scoped ESLint/Prettier and diff checks pass.
- Actual synthetic390/1440 light/dark checks pass: held/expired stock, keyboard expansion, server search/location filter, loading hides stale controls, report dialog/focus return, preserved reference draft, existing Batch/Movements views and Finance read-only visibility. All nine measured filter/help targets36/44px; no overflow/browser exceptions.
- Independent designer reviewed composition/source, approved six faithful assertion replacements and independently reran30/30 tests. Its mobile/loading findings and final desktop target findings are closed after independent inspection of the36/44px matrix; no bounded visual/runtime blocker remains.

This remains a scoped draft. Other demo tabs/workflows and current-main combined integration are unfinished; exact-head CI must be reviewed before any merge. Actual multi-page traversal was not exercised (fixture13 rows/page1of1); pagination handler is unchanged. No fresh full backend suite for this frontend-only slice. No backend, schema, grant or production data changes. The Stock Index overlaps pending STK46 UI; reconcile that separately.

Base c1e5fc05c0d231a28eeb3f2367ccc8adee0565c5. Evidence: `/workspace/kpone-validation/stock-workspace/REVIEW.md`, `resumed-fullfrontend.log`, `resumed-focused.log`, `resumed-build.log`, and `browser/` screenshots/results. Handover: `/workspace/kpone-validation/handover-2026-11-26/inventory.md`. No merge authorized.
